sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) > 0), "contact" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "city" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "email" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "registry_no" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "representative" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "representative_title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("seq" >= 0), "issue_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('draft', 'sent', 'paid', 'void')), "contract_ref" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "vat_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vat_on" IN (0, 1)), "vat_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1400 CHECK("vat_rate_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "notes_en" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes_ar" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scope_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("scope_on" IN (0, 1)), "scope_title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scope_overview" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scope_done" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scope_delivered" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scope_warranty" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("year", "seq")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contracts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clients (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "series" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("series" IN ('contract', 'quote')), "year" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("seq" >= 0), "amendment_no" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("amendment_no" >= 0), "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES contracts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('contract', 'quote', 'amendment')), "template_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "project_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "project_summary" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "preamble" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "closing" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "issue_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "signed_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('draft', 'sent', 'signed', 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled')), "jurisdiction" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("currency" IN ('EGP', 'USD', 'SAR', 'AED', 'EUR')), "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("total_minor" >= 0), "vars" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "out_of_scope" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unlocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("unlocked" IN (0, 1)), "history" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("series", "year", "seq", "amendment_no")) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER clients_soft_delete_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON clients WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices WHERE client_id = NEW.id AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contracts WHERE client_id = NEW.id AND deleted_at IS NULL))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'client has live documents');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoices_revive_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON invoices WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clients WHERE id = NEW.client_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'client is deleted');END

CREATE TRIGGER invoices_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON invoices WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clients WHERE id = NEW.client_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'client is deleted');END

CREATE TRIGGER contracts_revive_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF deleted_at ON contracts WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clients WHERE id = NEW.client_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'client is deleted');END

CREATE TRIGGER contracts_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON contracts WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clients WHERE id = NEW.client_id AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'client is deleted');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "city" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "email" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "website" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "invoice_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OM', "default_due_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30 CHECK("default_due_days" BETWEEN 0 AND 3650), "instapay" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "wallet" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "bank_iban" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes_en" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes_ar" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "backup_dir" TEXT NULL, "last_backup_at" INTEGER NULL, "legal_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "national_id_or_registry" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contract_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CT', "quote_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'QT', "default_jurisdiction" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'المحكمة الاقتصادية المختصة', "contract_western_digits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("contract_western_digits" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title_en" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "title_ar" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("currency" IN ('EGP', 'USD', 'SAR', 'AED', 'EUR')), PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "service" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cycle" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("cycle" IN ('one-time', 'monthly', 'annual')), "qty" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("qty" >= 0), "unit_price_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("unit_price_minor" >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clause_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("name")) > 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('contract', 'quote')), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "preamble" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "closing" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "var_defaults" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_clauses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clause_templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "optional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("optional" IN (0, 1)), "enabled_by_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled_by_default" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contract_clauses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contract_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "optional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("optional" IN (0, 1)), "from_library_clause_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scope_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contract_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "item" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "acceptance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_milestones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contract_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contracts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "percent_bp" INTEGER NULL CHECK("percent_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), "amount_minor" INTEGER NULL CHECK("amount_minor" >= 0), "trigger" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "due_date" TEXT NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX invoices_client ON invoices (client_id)
CREATE INDEX sections_invoice ON sections (invoice_id)
CREATE INDEX items_section ON items (section_id)
CREATE INDEX library_clauses_template ON library_clauses (template_id)
CREATE INDEX contracts_client ON contracts (client_id)
CREATE INDEX contracts_parent ON contracts (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX contract_clauses_contract ON contract_clauses (contract_id)
CREATE INDEX scope_items_contract ON scope_items (contract_id)
CREATE INDEX milestones_contract ON payment_milestones (contract_id)
CREATE INDEX milestones_invoice ON payment_milestones (invoice_id)
